title: feat(setup): Packages entry in Setup's Apps group
body:
Companion to objectui#2176 (Home builder cover + builder→app bridge), implementing the settled journey split: **Home cover = creation, /studio = 设计界面, the app = published front-end, Setup = administration**.

Package administration is an operator concern (ADR-0084: packages are Operate, out of the builder) — so `group_apps` in the Setup app gains a **Packages** entry bound to the console's existing `developer:packages` page, alongside the capability-plugin marketplace entries (Browse Marketplace / Installed Apps / Cloud Connection).

Per owner direction the classic Studio app is **not** removed in this step.

**Browser-verified** (worktree build, fresh db): Setup › Apps shows Packages first; the page renders (package list + New Package + Import). `platform-objects` tests **63/63** green.
